contract: C-5 / C-7: one market for every server. Ledger DataStore 'L_<id>' { Id, Seller, K, N, Price (one unit), At, Exp, St, Buyer, SoldAt, Paid } = the truth; MemoryStore maps (key map sorted by price, index { L, C }, sold hints) only list. List: checks (A23-133 gates, 72 h, 10 open, 20 a day, range) -> things out, Out Pend -> SAVE -> ledger row only if none -> Open -> map. Buy: checks (Lv5, own, price, room, owned weapon, 3 a day per seller, gold) -> gold out, In Pay -> SAVE -> one UpdateAsync Open -> Sold + Buyer (an ended / sold row never) -> deliver, or refund 'MarketRefund'. The seller's server pays total - 10% as bank gold 'Market' once (Done / Paid row), then marks the ledger Paid after its save. Cancel / end -> things back (room checked, owed rows wait). The join check settles Pend / Pay / Sold / ended rows. Switch off: no new listing / purchase, settling goes on.
limitations: The market quests (A23-133: first buy / first list / first sale paid) hook MarketService.Listed / Bought / Paid in their own commit; telemetry events are not in yet. MemoryStore limits (memory, requests) are only modelled as errors; the real budget is checked in Studio with API access.
